## FOREST PLOTS: DEMOGRAPHIC LINEAR REGRESSION RESULTS (Supplemental Figure 5)

```{r, warning=FALSE}

## Define model terms to exclude for plotting
terms_to_exclude <- c("(Intercept)", "age", "sexMale", "raceethnicity_collapsedNH-Black",
                      "raceethnicity_collapsedOther/Hispanic", 
                      "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")

## Age Acceleration
  ## Create filtered data for plots
filtered_df_adjusted <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_m_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)

  ## Factor and add labels for plotting
filtered_df_adjusted$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted$outcome, levels = rev(c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")), labels = rev(c("GrimAge", "MPOA", "Levine", "Horvath", "Hannum")))


## Array-wide (Global) Methylation
  ## Create filtered data for plots
filtered_df_adjustedGM <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_gm_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)

  ## Factor and add labels for plotting
filtered_df_adjustedGM$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjustedGM$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))

filtered_df_adjustedGM$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjustedGM$outcome, levels = c("Shore_mean", "Shelf_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Island_mean", "globalmethylation"), labels = c("Shore methylation", "Shelf methylation", "Open Sea methylation", "Island methylation", "Array-wide methylation"))


## Get plot
forest_plot_AA <- forest_plot(filtered_df_adjusted)
forest_plot_GM <- forest_plotGM(filtered_df_adjustedGM)
forest_plot_AA
forest_plot_GM

## Combine plots (Supplemental Figure 5)
forest_plotcombined <- plot_grid(forest_plot_AA, forest_plot_GM, ncol = 2, align = "h", axis = "l")

## Export
save_plot("Manuscript/Revisions/2026Oct12_forest_plots_m3_AA.svg", plot = forest_plot_AA, base_width = 22, base_height = 12)
save_plot("Manuscript/Revisions/2026Oct12_forest_plots_m3_GM.svg", plot = forest_plot_GM, base_width = 20, base_height = 12)

save_plot("Manuscript/Revisions/2026Oct12_supplfig5_combinedforest_plots_m3_AAGM.svg", plot = forest_plotcombined, base_width = 38, base_height = 10)


```
